Dance of the Reed Flutes / Danse des mirlitons — Eastern Wind Symphony
Composition: P. I. Tchaikovsky; conductor/arranger: Clark McAlister,
partially after John MacKenzie-Rogan; editor: Alfred Reed.
Publisher: Serenissima Music (2002–04). IMSLP recording #941628.
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
https://imslp.org/wiki/Special:ReverseLookup/941628
The complete final movement was extracted from the six-movement recording.
The resulting audio file is also distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

MP3 recordings were transcoded to AAC at 48–64 kb/s for web playback.
Attribution, source and license for the selected recording appear in Settings > Sound.
No endorsement by the composers, performers or publishers is implied.
